artworks.title: Colin Maillard
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in an outdoor setting. The figures are elegantly dressed and engaging in a playful game. In the center, a figure stands holding a stick with a blindfold on. The attire is detailed, with intricate folds and textures. The background features trees, an archway, and foliage. Architectural elements like columns and a curved arch are also present. The use of shading and contrast creates depth, and the detailing extends to textures of clothing and natural elements. The drawing captures a moment of playful elegance in a meticulously crafted scene.

artworks.title: Le Baiser à la Derobée (The Stolen Kiss)
artworks.artist: Nicolas François Regnault after Jean-Honoré Fragonard

artworks.title: Le Verrou
artworks.description: This print displays two individuals in a room. A man is on the left, facing away from us. In his right hand, he holds a woman by the waist, and his left hand is flung upward, positioned near a latch on a large door. He wears a white shirt, knee-length breeches, and is barefoot, his heels raised off the ground as if he is dancing. He has pale skin and curly brown hair. The woman is grabbing his shoulder, her head flung back. She appears to be coming down from a large bed on the right of the print, and one of her feet is on the floor while the other is raised in the air. She wears a garment with long, draped skirts, and some of them still lie on the bed. She has pale skin and light, curly hair. The bed on the right is unmade, with blankets draped across it and a large dent in the pillow. Heavy fabric hangs down around the bed. In the bottom right corner is a small table draped with fabric, with an overturned pitcher and small round object, perhaps an apple, resting on it. To the left of the table, a cushioned chair has been knocked on its side, with a short, dark dress draped over it. In the bottom left corner, small flowers lay on the floor near a cushioned footrest. The door and wall are dark gray. A bright beam of light is illuminating the embracing couple and the latched door behind them, with the rest of the room in shadow.

artworks.title: La Rose mal defendue (The Poorly Defended Rose)
artworks.medium: etching, wash manner, stipple, and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: In the image, a man and a woman are depicted. The man holds the woman, who appears to be stepping back or dancing. The woman faces the viewer, with a gentle expression and elaborately styled hair with curls and a large hat. She wears an elegant gown with ruffled details. The man stands behind her, looking engaged, with curled hair, dressed in late 18th-century formal attire. The woman holds a small bouquet. The background shows an opulent setting with a canopy bed, curtains, a side table with various items, and a richly patterned wall.

artworks.title: La tricoteuse endormie
artworks.description: The image depicts a young girl in a seated position, with her full upper body visible down to her waist. Her head is tilted to her right, with her eyes closed. She has delicate facial features and is wearing a bonnet that covers most of her hair. The girl's clothing consists of a long-sleeved dress with a plaid shawl wrapped around her shoulders. In her hands, she holds knitting needles, working on a piece of knitting. Beside her, there is a basket with a ball of yarn. The background is plain and dark.

artworks.title: La nuit passe, l'Aurore parait
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body depiction of a seated woman looking to her right. She has an elaborate updo with flowers, delicate facial features, and a serene expression. She wears a flowing gown, revealing her shoulders and upper chest, holding a bouquet of flowers in her left hand. Next to her is a childlike figure holding a torch. The background is an ethereal, cloud-like setting.

artworks.title: Charlotte Corday
artworks.artist: French 18th Century (previously attributed to Angélique Allais)
artworks.medium: color wash manner on laid paper

artworks.title: Le Tambourin
artworks.artist: Charles-Melchior Descourtis after Nicolas Antoine Taunay
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (outer framing line): 31 x 23.5 cm (12 3/16 x 9 1/4 in.)
plate: 39.2 x 29 cm (15 7/16 x 11 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a painting showing a lively outdoor gathering in a park setting. The scene captures elegantly dressed individuals engaged in various activities. In the foreground, a group of people sit on the grass, some chatting and others observing. To the left, a musician plays a drum. Children play with a small dog, adding joy to the scene. A statue on a pedestal is on the right, and lush trees surround the area. The sky has soft clouds, suggesting a pleasant day. The painting is in the style of François Boucher, known for pastoral themes and decorative elegance.

artworks.title: La jeunesse
artworks.artist: Nicolas de Larmessin IV after Nicolas Lancret
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of elegantly dressed young people engaging in various activities in a forested landscape. The scene includes individuals playing archery, conversing, laughing, and embracing under the trees. The setting conveys a sense of carefree youth in nature, with detailed shading adding to the overall whimsical and elegant atmosphere of the image.

artworks.title: La vieillesse
artworks.artist: Nicolas de Larmessin IV after Nicolas Lancret
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor gathering in a rural setting. The scene depicts a group of individuals engaged in leisurely activities near a simple, rustic home, surrounded by trees. The central figures are elderly and involved in various activities such as spinning wool. One person is sitting and spinning yarn at a wheel, while others sit and stand around. A dog rests on the ground nearby. The architecture of the house includes textured stone walls and a tall, narrow building. The composition includes elaborate detailing in the textures of clothing and foliage. French text at the bottom reads "La Vieillesse," meaning "Old Age."

artworks.title: Les oublies
artworks.description: The image includes four people standing and sitting outdoors. On the left side, a man stands, and next to him, a woman bends over a drum-like object. A child stands beside them. Another woman stands slightly turned to the front. Further right, a woman sits on a grassy mound, holding an object to her mouth. The background shows a landscape with hills and trees.

artworks.title: La cache-cache
artworks.description: The image depicts four women in different poses and outfits in a outdoor setting with trees and foliage in the background.

artworks.title: Le Départ du Courrier
artworks.description: The image shows a seated person playing a flute, leaning against a rock. The person is dressed in period clothing and has curly hair peeking out from under a hat. They are surrounded by a basket, a dog, and grazing sheep. The circular border is adorned with ivy, and the background is a dense forest with trees, bushes, and a sky visible through the branches.

artworks.title: L'Arrivée du Courrier
artworks.description: The image shows a woman kneeling in a forest clearing. She is leaning forward with one hand on a branch and the other pointing upwards. She is wearing a flowing garment and has detailed facial features. Nearby, there is a basket of flowers and cloth, a lamb resting, and a dog looking up. The circular frame around the image has foliage motifs. The background includes trees, water, and a bird flying. The image is monochromatic in shades of gray with detailed engravings.

artworks.title: L'enfance
artworks.artist: Nicolas de Larmessin IV after Nicolas Lancret
artworks.description: The image shows a group of children and women engaged in leisurely activities. The scene captures full-body views of several children dressed in historical attire with long, intricate dresses and coats, complete with decorative hats and ribbons. Most of the children are standing and playing with toys, such as a roller board with a long handle. The children have finely detailed facial features and carefully styled hair. To the left, a boy and a girl are pulling a toy, their expressions focused on the play. In the center, a woman sits holding a young child who gazes at the playing children. Around her, more children are involved in the games, some sitting and some standing. These figures are surrounded by large columns and intricate architecture indicative of an outdoor gallery or terrace. In the background, through the columns, the image shows a landscape with trees and hills under a cloudy sky. Additionally, the bottom of the image contains some text.

artworks.title: La Reine annonçant à Mme Bellegarde, des Juges, et la liberté de son mari en mai 1777
artworks.artist: Antoine-Jean Duclos after vicomte Charles Henri Desfosses
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of people gathered in an opulent interior. The individuals are dressed in elaborate 18th-century fashion, featuring women with ornate wigs, dresses, and men in fancy suits. Some people hold fans or wear hats. The setting includes large arched windows, classical sculptures, candlesticks, and decorative architectural elements.

artworks.title: L'enlevement nocturne
artworks.description: The image features several figures and animals in a dynamic scene. One person is climbing or perched on a tree, while another is being carried by a man. The individual in the tree has 18th-century fashion details such as delicate facial features, styled hair, and ornate clothing with ruffles, suggesting a dress. The man carrying the other person is dressed in typical 18th-century attire with a tricorn hat. A horse-drawn carriage with drivers and horses is depicted in motion, set against a backdrop of lush foliage and a church steeple. The composition is detailed with artistic embellishments and shading, creating a dramatic effect.

artworks.title: La Fuite à dessein (The Pre-Arranged Flight)
artworks.artist: Charles François Adrien Macret and Jacques Couché after Jean-Honoré Fragonard
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in full-body view positioned against a breezy landscape. She appears to be in mid-motion, with her arms extended and her body slightly angled forward. She has a surprised or playful expression, with wide eyes and slightly open lips. Her hair is styled in an updo with flowers. She is wearing a flowing, knee-length gown with puffed sleeves and a wrap-around bodice that billows around her. Tall grasses surround her, and a second figure, possibly male, is partially visible behind her. The background features a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Rose et Colas
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Blaise Simonet after Pierre-Antoine Baudouin
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in a rustic indoor setting. One person is a man standing in the center with short, curly hair and period clothing, holding a floral garland. The other person is a woman partially hidden behind a draped cloth on a wooden railing. In the foreground are a spinning wheel, chair, and a barrel with straw and a small animal. Harvested crops like wheat, cabbage, and potatoes are visible, along with a loft space accessible by a staircase. The background features a textured stone wall.

artworks.title: La Petite Thérèse
artworks.description: This print shows a man and a woman surrounded by plants. On the left is the man, who is facing the right and leaning forward with his arms extended. He wears a dark, wide-brimmed hat, a long-sleeved jacket and shirt with a ruffled white collar, and dark trousers. The woman on the right faces us, appearing to move towards the right. The man is grabbing her arm with one hand and the fabric of her skirt with the other hand. She wears a light-colored dress with a neckline so low that it reveals her breasts, a ruffled white collar, a draped skirt, and puffed sleeves. Her hair is tied up into a bun on top of her head. Both people have pale skin, and the man is smiling slightly, while the woman has a neutral expression, her mouth partially open. They are both surrounded by twisting vines and dense leaves. The text "La Petite Therese" is below the print, alongside a decorative coat of arms featuring two figures and a shield.

artworks.title: Les sabots
artworks.description: The image depicts two people outdoors. A man is lying on the ground while a woman sits beside him holding a basket. The man has curly hair and a clean-shaven face. The woman also has curly hair and wears a dress with a hat. There is a hat on the ground next to the man and the woman's basket contains flowers. The background shows a lush landscape with trees, foliage, and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Noce de Village (Village Wedding)
artworks.artist: Charles-Melchior Descourtis after Nicolas Antoine Taunay
artworks.medium: color etching and wash-manner engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor gathering under tents. The scene is composed of several figures gathered under a makeshift tent in what appears to be a village setting. The tent is constructed with wooden poles and draped fabric, providing shelter for a group of seated and standing figures. The background is dominated by trees and a cloudy sky. In the foreground, there are various objects such as a jug, baskets, and bundles of sticks.

artworks.title: Foire de Village
artworks.artist: Charles-Melchior Descourtis after Nicolas Antoine Taunay
artworks.description: This print shows a village fair with various people engaged in different activities. To the right, two performers are on a stage, one of whom is dressed in a colorful costume and wearing a black mask, the other dressed in pale clothing. A young boy with a drum is next to the stage, his back to us, and two dogs are nearby on the left. In the background, tents are set up, and a crowd of people gather around them, many facing the stage. Trees with green and brown leaves arch overhead. The sky is a blend of pastel blue and cream colors, and the color palette of the print is mainly earthy tones with pops of color from clothing. Below the print are a few lines of text and what looks like a crest with a shield.”

artworks.title: Tête de Flore
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in blue, black, and red
artworks.description: This print depicts a person with a gentle expression, looking towards us. They have pale skin, rosy cheeks, large eyes, a long nose, and short, wavy brown hair with flowers in it. They are holding a basket of flowers. The person wears a light pink garment with a low neck and a pink bow below their chin. There seem to be more flowers attached to their dress. The background is a muted dark blue shade, and the print is surrounded by a border of beige paper with a few lines of text at the bottom.
